PASS = released document matches the approved quote exactly, includes required disclosures, and states an expiry date, with delivery confirmed. FAIL = any mismatch, missing disclosure/expiry, or unconfirmed delivery.
On FAIL, the release is retracted/held, corrected, and re-approved before re-sending; delivery failures are retried and logged, escalating to the Senior Underwriter if unresolved.
Acceptance criteria: only the approved quote version is released, with disclosures and a stated expiry date, and delivery to the broker is confirmed and recorded.
Evidence lands on the PolicyCenter account file (transmittal + delivery confirmation) and /Underwriting/Quotes/<account-id>/released/.
In-scope effective dates = the quote release date through the stated expiry date (e.g. 30 days); the quote is valid for binding only within that window unless formally extended.
